Surfhouse Residences

Condominium in Cherngtalay (Choeng Thale), near Bang Tao / Laguna
HomeNew ProjectsSurfhouse Residences

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

Surfhouse Residences is a boutique seven-storey condominium of 34 residences in Cherngtalay, Thalang, Phuket, developed and managed by SALA Hospitality Group. Units range from one to three bedrooms. Facilities include an 18-metre saltwater pool, gym, lobby lounge and concierge service.

Facilities & amenities

  • 18 m saltwater swimming pool
  • Gym / fitness centre
  • Laundry room
  • Lobby social area
  • Covered parking
  • 24/7 security and CCTV
  • 24/7 concierge
  • Landscaped gardens
  • Pet-friendly
  • Rental management and housekeeping by SALA

Frequently asked questions

Where is Surfhouse Residences?

Surfhouse Residences is a boutique low-rise condominium project in Cherngtalay (Choeng Thale), near Bang Tao / Laguna, Phuket, developed by SALA Hospitality Group.

What is the starting price of Surfhouse Residences?

Agent advertised price is ฿8,400,000, last checked 2026-11-14. Prices and availability change, so ask us on WhatsApp for the current figures.

What ownership is offered at Surfhouse Residences?

Sources list freehold ownership. Always confirm the exact title and conditions with a Thai lawyer before buying; this is general information, not legal advice.

When will Surfhouse Residences be ready?

Current status: under construction. Dates can change, so please confirm with us.
